visual_connections.description: Developers push code changes to GitHub repository
Developers access UI and API endpoints hosted on EC2
GitHub webhook triggers Lambda function upon code push
Lambda creates analysis request and sends it to SQS queue
ECS Fargate service pulls analysis tasks from SQS queue
ECS Fargate worker clones source code from GitHub repository
ECS Fargate sends completed analysis report to EC2 via API
EC2 stores incoming analysis reports in Aurora database
ECS Fargate Compute Engine pulls reports from Aurora and updates computed code quality metrics back to Aurora
Compute Engine writes optimized search metrics data into Elasticsearch
